notes.title: Beta 1.0 version !
notes.notes:
Hey,

Hajji VR is now in Beta 1.0.
What does it mean exactly ? Well we removed the internal patcher as the game is now stable and we don't need to do daily update on it.
We've also prepared some "stuff" for the Mecca map and the "teaching mode" including our AI's.

We are super excited to show you soon our work = D 

Visit our discord for more informations : 
https://discord.gg/3Fj4HSDa68
